title: Disagreement-Guided Weak-to-Strong Routing
abstract: arXiv:2610.22245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices and robotic systems to meet cost and latency constraints, yet their limited capabilities can make reliable deployment challenging. Stronger models can provide assistance when needed, but deciding when to route a weak-model response to a stronger model often relies on signals of response correctness. In open-ended and agentic tasks, however, obtaining such signals can require costly ground-truth supervision that is difficult to obtain at scale. We revisit the foundations of weak-to-strong routing and ask whether routing decisions can instead be guided by signals that do not require ground-truth supervision. We first characterize the optimal weak-to-strong routing policy, while allowing for multiple weak-model responses generated through local inference. translated_title: 分歧引导的弱到强路由
translated_abstract: 小型语言模型越来越多地被部署在边缘设备和机器人系统上以满足成本与延迟约束，然而其有限的能力使得可靠部署面临挑战。更强的模型可以在需要时提供协助，但决定何时将弱模型的响应路由给更强模型，通常依赖于响应正确性的信号。然而，在开放式和智能体任务中，获取此类信号往往需要昂贵且难以大规模获得的标准答案监督。我们重新审视了弱到强路由的基础问题，并探讨路由决策是否可以由无需标准答案监督的信号来引导。我们首先刻画了最优的弱到强路由策略，同时允许通过本地推理生成多个弱模型响应。在此基础上，我们推导出一种基于模型间比较的最优路由的原则性近似方法……
tldr: 该论文提出无需标准答案监督、基于模型间分歧信号来决定何时将弱模型响应路由给更强模型的方法，以降低弱到强路由对昂贵监督信号的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a disagreement-guided weak-to-strong routing method that determines when to escalate a weak model's response to a stronger model without requiring costly ground-truth supervision.
